description: 30-day monitor for one endpoint with alerts on payTo or price changes, delisting, spec regressions and downtime, via polling or webhooks. Returns a one-time secret, keep it.

endpoint.description: Full x402 resource URL to watch. It must already be in our observation set.

events.description: Event types to subscribe to (default all): payto_change, price_change, asset_network_change, spec_regression, delisting, liveness_down, liveness_recovered, liveness_flapping, latency_regression.

liveness_sensitivity_n.description: Consecutive missed probes before liveness_down surfaces to you (1=paranoid … 10=relaxed; default 2).

slack_url.description: Optional Slack or Discord incoming webhook URL(s). Single string or array; max 5.

webhook_url.description: Optional signed HTTPS webhook URL(s) for push delivery. Single string or array; max 5.

name: x402_watch_create
title: x402 Trust watch: create 30-day endpoint monitor
